channel.title: WefieHome Owner Insights
channel.description: Guides for property owners in Kuala Lumpur and the Klang Valley on Airbnb management, short-term vs long-term rental and the KL short-term rental market.

item.title: How Much Does Airbnb Management Cost in Kuala Lumpur?
item.dc:creator: Ivan Ng
item.description: Airbnb management in KL usually costs 15–25% of revenue. See what the fee covers, what owners still pay, and a worked example of a monthly payout.

item.title: Airbnb vs Long-Term Rental in Kuala Lumpur: What Property Owners Should Consider
item.dc:creator: Ivan Ng
item.description: Comparing Airbnb and long-term rental for a KL condo? See income, costs, risk, building rules and the effort involved, with an illustrative example.

item.title: How Many Airbnbs Are There in Kuala Lumpur? Market Size and Trend for Owners (2026)
item.dc:creator: Ivan Ng
item.description: Kuala Lumpur has about 18,500–20,000 active Airbnb listings, up 27–38% in a year. What the growth means for owners, plus the rules to watch in 2026.
